phenomenon: First book-search entry screenshot shows search header with empty body and no keyboard; early layout dump contains SceneBoard only. Later pre-manual-click dump contains focused input, search history and input-method window.
evidenceBoundary: Existing VM captures and operation records read and copied only; no device command issued by this audit. The early dump and screenshot are sequential captures. Re-entry screenshots support visible behavior, not exact native-frame latency.
conclusion: VM re-entry automatically opens the keyboard after only the bookshelf search action, without tapping the input: frame 0 shows the sliding IME, straight caret and search history; frames 1 and 2 show the complete keyboard. The original first-open captures are retained: they do not locate the cold first-entry delay or measure its latency. No production change is justified by this evidence.
open: Cold first-entry time to keyboard/history was not precisely measured; the initial sequential capture cannot locate the delay cause.
VM screenshots are not a physical-device performance measurement or user acceptance.

codeAudit.finding: openSearch resets then requests the one-shot input focus before setting route and opening the orchestrator; no history/source await gates focus.
aboutToAppear consumes the focus request before accepting the current stable publication; searchBar passes the resulting State boolean to ReaderSearchField.

The mounted/generation-guarded FrameCallback.onIdle requests the native id; TextInput explicitly enables keyboard on focus. Local SDK API defines onIdle at the next idle-frame end, requesting a frame if absent. No determined lost-focus defect from current artifacts.
open publishes initial and dispatches source/history independently; history completion publishes only for the current untouched initial session. Sources do not gate this callback.
History decode waits only for search.history.list, then validates returned keywords. Source projection yields every 32 rows. Runtime request/IME/frame latency is not measured by these source facts.
Empty initial history intentionally renders no history body; later native history text proves initial publication is not permanently frozen.

Module latch prevents repeated font registration; BookshelfPage:196 and BookshelfEmptyPage:56 invoke this same function before entering search. This excludes re-registering the font set on ordinary search entry, not native glyph or input-method cold loading.

minimalRemainingEvidence: No further VM probing is required for the automatic-keyboard re-entry behavior. Cold first-entry latency remains OPEN; any later measurement must distinguish action dispatch, actual native presentation and screenshot-command overhead.
